chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Aslam, the mawlā of ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, who said:
I wanted to write to Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام to ask him: may a man use depilatory paste while he is in a state of janābah?

He said: So he wrote to me, to begin with: “Depilatory paste increases the cleanliness of the person in janābah, but a man should not have intercourse while dyed, and a woman who is dyed should not be approached for intercourse.”

key_terms.النُّورَةُ: depilatory paste used for cleansing and hair removal
key_terms.جُنُبٌ: a person in a state of janābah requiring ghusl
key_terms.مُخْتَضِبًا: having applied dye such as henna
key_terms.مُخْتَضِبَةٌ: a woman having applied dye such as henna
key_terms.يَتَنَوَّرُ: to use depilatory paste for removing hair

ai.seo_question: Can a person in janābah use depilatory paste, and is intercourse disliked while dyed?
ai.summary: This hadith states that using depilatory paste while in a state of janābah is permissible and even increases cleanliness. It also gives a ruling of etiquette or restraint regarding intercourse when either the man or the woman is in a state of being dyed with henna or similar coloring.
